title: GGML Backend Management
summary: This module provides core functionalities for managing GGML backends, including discovery, initialization, memory allocation for computation graphs and tensors, scheduling graph execution, and facilitating data transfer and comparison across different hardware backends.

nodes.label: Allocate Graph Tensors
nodes.title: Allocate Graph Tensors
nodes.description: Allocates memory for all tensors within a computation graph using a graph allocator, handling reallocations if needed.

nodes.label: Reserve Graph Memory Size
nodes.title: Reserve Graph Memory Size
nodes.description: Calculates and reserves the necessary memory sizes for a computation graph across multiple buffers without actual allocation.

nodes.label: Allocate Context Tensors
nodes.title: Allocate Context Tensors
nodes.description: Allocates tensors for a given GGML context on a specified backend using its default buffer type.

nodes.label: Get Context Tensors Size
nodes.title: Get Context Tensors Size
nodes.description: Determines the total memory size required to allocate tensors for a GGML context using a specific buffer type.

nodes.label: Free Graph Allocator
nodes.title: Free Graph Allocator
nodes.description: Releases all resources and memory associated with a graph allocator, including its internal buffers and data structures.

nodes.label: Create Graph Allocator
nodes.title: Create Graph Allocator
nodes.description: Initializes and returns a new graph allocator instance, configured for a specified backend buffer type.

nodes.label: Get Allocator Buffer Size
nodes.title: Get Allocator Buffer Size
nodes.description: Retrieves the allocated size of a specific buffer managed by the graph allocator, avoiding double-counting shared buffers.

nodes.label: Load All Backends
nodes.title: Load All Backends
nodes.description: Discovers and loads all available GGML backend implementations from predefined paths or system configurations.

nodes.label: Initialize Backend by Name
nodes.title: Initialize Backend by Name
nodes.description: Initializes a specific GGML backend by its registered name, optionally with custom parameters.

nodes.label: Get Backend Registration by Name
nodes.title: Get Backend Registration by Name
nodes.description: Searches for and returns the registration entry for a GGML backend based on its unique name.

nodes.label: Initialize Backend by Type
nodes.title: Initialize Backend by Type
nodes.description: Initializes a GGML backend based on its device type (e.g., CPU, GPU), with optional configuration parameters.

nodes.label: Initialize Best Backend
nodes.title: Initialize Best Backend
nodes.description: Automatically initializes the most performant available backend, prioritizing GPU, then iGPU, then CPU.

nodes.label: Compute Graph with Scheduler
nodes.title: Compute Graph with Scheduler
nodes.description: Executes a computation graph using a backend scheduler, synchronizing after asynchronous computation.

nodes.label: Reserve Scheduler Memory Size
nodes.title: Reserve Scheduler Memory Size
nodes.description: Calculates and reserves the total memory required by a computation graph for a backend scheduler, splitting the graph as needed.

nodes.label: Reserve & Allocate Scheduler Memory
nodes.title: Reserve & Allocate Scheduler Memory
nodes.description: Reserves and allocates memory for a computation graph within a backend scheduler, preparing it for execution.

nodes.label: Compare Backend Computations
nodes.title: Compare Backend Computations
nodes.description: Compares the results of a computation graph executed on two different backends, using a provided callback for verification.

nodes.label: Create Backend Scheduler
nodes.title: Create Backend Scheduler
nodes.description: Constructs a new backend scheduler instance, configuring it with multiple backends, buffer types, and parallelization options.

nodes.label: Asynchronously Copy Tensor
nodes.title: Asynchronously Copy Tensor
nodes.description: Initiates an asynchronous copy of tensor data from a source backend to a destination backend, synchronizing if async copy is not supported.

nodes.label: Allocate Backend Buffer
nodes.title: Allocate Backend Buffer
nodes.description: Allocates a generic memory buffer of a specified size using the default buffer type of a given backend.

nodes.label: Get Backend Alignment
nodes.title: Get Backend Alignment
nodes.description: Retrieves the required memory alignment for buffers allocated by a specific GGML backend.

nodes.label: Get Backend Max Buffer Size
nodes.title: Get Backend Max Buffer Size
nodes.description: Returns the maximum size of a single memory buffer that can be allocated by a given GGML backend.

nodes.label: Copy Tensor to CPU Buffer
nodes.title: Copy Tensor to CPU Buffer
nodes.description: Copies tensor data directly into a CPU-managed backend buffer, assuming the source is also host-accessible.

nodes.label: Get Buffer Max Size
nodes.title: Get Buffer Max Size
nodes.description: Retrieves the maximum size supported by a specific backend buffer instance.

nodes.label: Set Buffer Usage
nodes.title: Set Buffer Usage
nodes.description: Assigns a usage type (e.g., for weights, activations) to a backend buffer, potentially affecting its allocation strategy.

nodes.label: Create CPU Buffer from Pointer
nodes.title: Create CPU Buffer from Pointer
nodes.description: Constructs a CPU backend buffer object from an existing memory pointer and size, ensuring proper alignment.

groups.label: Backend Discovery & Initialization
groups.title: Backend Discovery & Initialization
groups.description: Handles the process of finding, registering, and initializing different GGML hardware backends (CPU, GPU, etc.) for use.

groups.label: Graph Allocator Management
groups.title: Graph Allocator Management
groups.description: Manages the lifecycle of graph allocators, including creation, memory reservation, allocation of graph-specific tensors, and freeing resources.

groups.label: Context & Backend Buffer Allocation
groups.title: Context & Backend Buffer Allocation
groups.description: Provides functions for allocating memory buffers for GGML contexts and general backend use, including querying size, alignment, and setting usage.

groups.label: Graph Scheduling & Computation
groups.title: Graph Scheduling & Computation
groups.description: Orchestrates the execution of computation graphs across backends, including creating schedulers, reserving memory, and performing graph computations.

groups.label: Cross-Backend Data & Verification
groups.title: Cross-Backend Data & Verification
groups.description: Facilitates the transfer of tensor data between different backends and provides utilities for comparing computation results for verification.
